_readme: Optional: map a voice category (coin, near, jump, slide, jet, land, caught, hit, ped) or an exact Bangla line to an audio file in this folder, e.g. { "coin": "coin.mp3", "ভাই, রাস্তা দেখে দৌড়ান!": "rasta.mp3" }. Files must be original or properly licensed recordings. When empty, the game uses the device's Bangla text-to-speech (if installed) plus on-screen captions.
